_comment: Generators whose media a FUTURISTIC record may commit to the registry. This list IS the registry's claim about the brand's media provenance, so extending it is a governance decision, not a refactor. Single source of truth: apps/api/src/futuristic.ts (verifier) and scripts/ship-registry.mjs (drift watchdog) both read this file, so the rule the registry enforces and the rule the watchdog assumes can never disagree.
